blocks.text: An adjective in the comparative degree may be followed by the object of comparison in the Genitive case, or by a phrase consisting of "**чем**" plus the object of comparison in the Nominative case: *Ваш автомобиль новее моего автомобиля. Ваш автомобиль новее, чем мой автомобиль.*
Note the use of the preposition "**на** + Acc." in such expressions as: **старше на два года** — 2 years older; **длиннее на пять метров** — 5 meters longer.
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–81.
Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: В ___ (than) разница между религией и культом?
exercises.prompt: What's the difference between a religion and a cult?
Male chauvinists believe themselves to be superior to any woman.
exercises.why: **всякий → всякой** (gen. sg. f., agreeing with женщины). Declines like русский. Ending -ая → -ой.

exercises.q: М-р Маррей просит видеоповтор на правой дальней ___ (линия) подачи. Был зафиксирован аут.
exercises.prompt: Mr. Murray is challenging the call on the right far service line. The ball was called out.
exercises.why: **линия → линии** (prep. sg.: на + prepositional). Declines like армия. Ending -я → -и.

exercises.q: Ничтожные люди подобны бутылке с узким горлышком: ___ (than) меньше налито, тем больше шума при выливании.
exercises.prompt: It is with narrow-souled people as with narrow necked bottles: the less they have in them, the more noise they make in pouring it out.
This argument is nothing more than rhetoric.
